name: Days at the Sleepy Cat Bookstore
source:
"Days at the Sleepy Cat Bookstore" follows Steve, or your name here, a 30-something hyena-man who quit his corporate job to take over ownership of his favorite bookstore. Feeling lost and overwhelmed Steve takes the steps to re-open the bookstore and meets some handsome fellas along the way. 

[From [url=https://burntwafflesvn.itch.io/days-at-the-sleepy-cat-bookstore]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《瞌睡猫书店的日子》讲述了史蒂夫（这里是你的名字）的故事，他是一位30多岁的鬣狗人，他辞去了公司工作，接管了他最喜欢的书店的所有权。感到失落和不知所措的史蒂夫决定重新开张书店，并一路上遇到了一些英俊的小伙子。

[来自[url=https://burntwafflesvn.itch.io/days-at-the-sleepy-cat-bookstore]Itch.io[/url]]
